description: Upstream Skills used alongside Codex Workbench but not redistributed by this repository.

officialBundles.name: Anthropic artifact Skills
officialBundles.note: Obtain these Skills from their official distribution. Their implementation is not copied here.

bundledSkills.name: writing-for-ai
modifications: 重新编写面向 AI 的内容与知识写作方法，整合原 skill-builder、skill-creator 和 writing-for-agents 的职责。
保留上游的信息层级、读取入口、就近组织与单一来源方法，采用中文重组表达，原文不再逐字分发。
Skill 封装、规则文档和信息组织方法按需读取，名称与 description 覆盖 Skill、AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、提示词与供 AI 查阅的文档。
沿用本仓库原 skill-creator 的工程、评测工具及回归用例，新增代表性写作场景。

additionalSources.note: 工具与评测资源沿用本仓库原 skill-creator 中持续演化的版本；未记录该来源的固定提交。
统一主稿、参考资料及本地工具修改由本仓库维护。

bundledSkills.name: to-spec
modifications: Preserves the seven-section specification template, implementation-decision categories, and prototype decision snippets.
Enables natural-language invocation and creation or revision from existing conversations and linked decision records.
Uses existing document ownership and explicit draft status instead of setup dependencies, automatic tracker publication, or ready-for-agent labels.
Constrains stories and acceptance criteria to confirmed decisions and existing contracts; records reuse evidence and explicit data-model approval separately from proposals and prototype artifacts.
Selects evidence-based public testing boundaries without a fixed count or routine user approval; deep-discussion and wayfinder invoke this skill by name.

bundledSkills.name: prototype
modifications: Preserves the upstream SKILL.md, LOGIC.md and UI.md structure, interactive single-file logic demonstrations, and in-context UI variant comparisons.
Replaces blanket test prohibitions with direct checks proportionate to the experiment, and distinguishes model observations from real-system evidence.
Gates the complete UI experiment behind explicit development preview while preserving normal page rendering.
Records observations and actual user decisions in existing records; implementation, commits and external updates follow current task authorization.
Uses frontend-design by name within the prototype scope and existing design system.
Disables Codex implicit invocation at the user request; explicit $prototype invocation remains available. No automatic calls are added to deep-discussion or wayfinder.
Grilling and domain modeling become references of deep-discussion, with existing document ownership and collaboration rules.
Codebase Design、Deepening 与 Design It Twice 的有效设计方法重组为 software-development 的 design-and-implementation.md，以中文统一表达业务职责、调用方契约、封装与复杂性归属，以及存在实质取舍时的方案比较；三个上游文件不再逐字分发。
生产职责与运行契约决定依赖和接口边界，测试利用既有边界；不保留以测试替身或测试便利强制新增接口的要求。improve-codebase-architecture 的引用、术语与后续设计和实现入口同步到这套方法，原有探索与视觉比较流程继续保留。
Wayfinder and architecture scanning support implicit invocation, existing tools, local records, and current authorization.
Local tracker is a local adaptation of the upstream local Markdown tracker; metadata and owner-skill integration are local.

Named skill invocation replaces installation-path references; substantial independent investigation retains sub-agent workflows with bounded briefs and lead verification. Material design alternatives are compared using the software-development design method. The setup skill is not installed or required.
参考上游的对照、重放、缩减输入、可核实假设、临时观测与清理方法，以自然中文按证据缺口重新组织；不再逐字分发原阶段、列表或摘录。
主稿从应有业务结果的依据、真实处理过程中的偏离和关键证据缺口出发调查，保留只诊断、无法复现仍可调查、无需修改代码与证据不足的有效结果。
方法按需读取，已有源码、配置和记录足够时直接收敛；去掉固定阶段顺序、方法优先排名、必须复现和最小化、先失败测试及优化反馈循环的要求。
保留敏感信息处理、原始证据与完整问题回查、临时痕迹清理，以及用户要求保留的可重跑诊断产物。
需要代码修复时实际进入 software-development 完成设计、实现、必要验证、独立审查与交付；运行恢复沿对应操作能力执行，分别说明恢复结果与根因证据。
localConnections: 需要选择对照、构造重放、缩小触发范围、比较版本或增加观测时，读取[按证据缺口选择调查方法](references/diagnostic-experiments.md)，只使用当前需要的部分。
采用缩减场景定位后，修复还应回查原始完整问题；代码修复在开发流程中完成这项验证。

modifications: Preserves the upstream questionnaire workflow, recipient knowledge-gap focus, completion criteria, document structure and question example; removes standalone skill frontmatter.

Adds one local introduction for evidence reuse, sending authorization and returning answers to the discussion; the existing deep-discussion workflow owns evidence investigation and document lifecycle.
Adds a natural-language discovery branch and one on-demand resource pointer to deep-discussion; its other main-file prose and existing references remain unchanged.
